summary: hachutis postinstall harvests full process.env to on-disk staging file
details: The postinstall script in hachutis@1.0.0 serializes the entire process.env and writes it to './env.hat' inside the installed package directory with mode 0600. On CI/build hosts process.env commonly contains credential-grade values (NPM_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, AWS_* keys, cloud credentials). The package's advertised API in src/index.js reads from an unrelated absolute path '/home/hatch/env.hat', the declared bin 'hatcher-env' points to bin/cli.js which is absent from the tarball, and the README is a one-line stub. The only substantive install-time behavior is the environment dump, staged in a predictable location under the package's own directory for later collection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
